findings.title: 45 prune-tombstoned integrity files resurrected in git HEAD — traced to a SINGLE anomalous workspace-sync run (06-14T16:22), guard otherwise working; static, self-draining residue
findings.evidence: check-prune-resurrection.js RC=3, 45 files (18 narrative-cite-audit + 27 verify-pending-run). Per-commit cross-ref vs 2018-path archive set: only commit 8b358ede (06-14T16:22:12Z) has true-resurrections>0 (39); 7 subsequent ws-sync cycles = 0. 16:22 run report self-labeled 'Clean run: 59 new files added' with 0 git-deleted-authoritative skips. Adjacent runs logged 96 correct skips. Files stuck in HEAD because smart_copy's dst-exists branch no-ops once present.
findings.root_cause: Per-run GIT_DELETED_SET build (workspace-sync.md ~line 648-666) is a single point of failure with a PERMISSIVE failure mode: empty/short set -> dst-absent branch falls through to permissive PROP-082 date proxy -> bulk resurrection, with no fail-closed check and no persisted git_deleted_count for detection.
findings.recommended_action: PROP-103 (authored this run): fail-closed when GIT_DELETED_SET is empty/short while prune archives are non-empty + persist git_deleted_count in the run report. Residue self-drains on next scheduled prune (09:00 local); no manual push needed.
findings.severity_rationale: Downgraded from the canary's blunt 'major' to moderate: bounded static residue (45 files, not growing), steady-state guard verified working, self-draining on next prune. Honest counter-risk: if the empty-set mechanism recurs, the next prune's re-deletes could re-leak — the next prune cycle is the true verification.
findings.verification_next: After the next prune-integrity run (~08:00 UTC today), re-run check-prune-resurrection.js: expect 45 -> 0 and stay 0 across following ws-sync cycles. If it re-leaks, prioritize PROP-103 integration.
